name: Legal Logic Analysis
examples_zh: 分析一份跨境SaaS服务合同：先判断适用管辖，再列出付款、数据合规和违约责任风险
针对员工离职带走客户名单的情况，梳理关键事实、法律争点、证据缺口和下一步行动
审查这个房屋租赁纠纷，区分已确认事实、待核实事实、可能适用法律和诉讼风险
examples_en: Analyze a cross-border SaaS contract by identifying jurisdiction, payment risks, data-compliance issues, and liability exposure
For an employee who left with a client list, map the key facts, legal issues, evidence gaps, and next actions
Review this residential lease dispute and separate confirmed facts, facts to verify, applicable law, and litigation risks
description_zh: 系统化法律推理分析（管辖权、事实、争点、适用法律、风险评估）
description_en: Systematic legal reasoning: jurisdiction, issues, law, risk & action
